scopeLabel: Source-scoped Au catalyst deposition, chemical beam epitaxy growth, composition and growth-interruption controls, catalyst-stop preparations, microscopy specimens and five single-nanowire optical contexts. All nine main pages were read in text and images. Exact physical batch identities, unlisted growth times and individual alloy line pressures remain unknown. Figure specimens are not silently joined to unreported recipes. This is not a complete laboratory SOP or a full-paper narrative Reader.

availability.morphology_illustration: Source microscopy and the original truncated-pyramid schematic are retained. A generic cylinder or sphere would misrepresent the square, tapered nanowire and embedded dot; no such finite-particle geometry is inferred. Optional bulk InP/InAs reference cells are restricted to two qualified phase contexts.

bindings.caption: Grow the pure InAs segment. The source does not separately report this control’s segment-growth duration; 10 min from Figure 3a is not inherited. Growth follows directly after the InP stem without GI 2; an exact temperature transition is not separately stated. All precursor pressures are measured gas-line pressures used as flux references, not chamber total pressure, gas dose or molar concentration. Qualified CBE chamber/substrate schematic; no unreported chamber shape, gas manifold, heater geometry or liquid reaction vessel is asserted.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
